bio_en: Hamazasp Baghishtsian, known as Salman, was born in Van in 1883 into a known family and graduated from the Etchmiadzin seminary, knowing four European languages. Already ill with tuberculosis, he returned to Van, teaching by day and working for the revolution by night. He was a member of the ARF Vaspurakan Central Committee in 1906 alongside Aram, Vana Ishkhan and Vana Sargis, and in 1907 set out, against his doctors' advice, as a delegate to the ARF General Congress. He died on 26 June 1907 at the age of 24, asking to die among Armenian comrades.
